afs_lohnsteuer_2022.used_for: Berlin-wide taxpayers and total income (Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte), shown as the city reference for income.

blickpunkt_schule_2026.caveat: District figures, counted where the school is (pupils may live in another district). The report notes that school populations differ a lot between districts.
blickpunkt_schule_2026.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Bildung, Jugend und Familie, Referat I C
blickpunkt_schule_2026.title: Blickpunkt Schule, Bericht 2025/2026 — Tab. 3.2.3 (Förderprognose) and Abb. 5.1.2 (Schulabschlüsse in den Bezirken)
blickpunkt_schule_2026.used_for: Per district: school leavers from general schools by qualification, and primary pupils by secondary-school recommendation.

bodenrichtwerte_2026.caveat: Bodenrichtwerte are typical land prices for a zone, not values of individual properties. Land for houses and for blocks of flats are different markets, so each home is only compared with land of the same kind.
bodenrichtwerte_2026.title: Bodenrichtwerte zum 01.01.2026 (Vektordaten, WGS84)
bodenrichtwerte_2026.used_for: Standard land value (EUR/m² of plot) of the residential, core and mixed zones that the area's home sample points lie in.

ibb_tabellenband_2025.caveat: District medians from listings, not signed contracts. Neighbourhoods within a district differ; the range shows how much.
ibb_tabellenband_2025.publisher: Investitionsbank Berlin (IBB); data: VALUE Marktdatenbank, RegioKontext GmbH
ibb_tabellenband_2025.title: IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025 — Tabellenband, Tab. 25 ‘Angebotsmieten nach Bezirken 2025’
ibb_tabellenband_2025.used_for: Median asking rent (net cold) per district, and the range that 80% of offers fall into.

mss_2023.caveat: The status index combines four indicators of residents' social and economic situation (e.g. unemployment, welfare receipt). It describes averages, not people. The Senate doesn't index 6 planning areas (under 300 residents or statistical outliers); they're left out of the average.
mss_2023.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin
mss_2023.title: Monitoring Soziale Stadtentwicklung 2023 — Tabelle 1: Gesamtindex Soziale Ungleichheit (Status/Dynamik-Index) auf Planungsraum-Ebene
mss_2023.used_for: Status-Index class (1 high – 4 very low) and residents of each of the 542 planning areas, weighted by residents up to Bezirksregionen.

openstreetmap_geofabrik.caveat: Community-mapped: very complete in Berlin but not official. Distances are straight lines from homes, so real walks are a little longer.
openstreetmap_geofabrik.publisher: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), extract by Geofabrik GmbH
openstreetmap_geofabrik.title: OpenStreetMap — Geofabrik ‘berlin-latest-free’ GeoPackage
openstreetmap_geofabrik.used_for: Cafés, shops, doctors, bars, culture and sport venues; residential land; lakes, rivers and forests.

openstreetmap_geofabrik_2026_11_12.caveat: As complete as volunteer mapping; straight-line distances understate real walks a little.
openstreetmap_geofabrik_2026_11_12.publisher: © OpenStreetMap contributors; extract by Geofabrik GmbH
openstreetmap_geofabrik_2026_11_12.title: OpenStreetMap — Berlin extract (Geofabrik, free GeoPackage), 2026-11-12
openstreetmap_geofabrik_2026_11_12.used_for: Hospitals, doctors, pharmacies, schools, Kitas, playgrounds, parks, stops, parking ticket machines, car parks and streets, measured from 100 m sample points on residential land.

pks_kriminalitaetsatlas.caveat: Reported offences per 100,000 registered residents. Areas many people visit (centre, nightlife, transport hubs) read higher than what residents experience; the police note a high rate can also reflect liveliness and popularity.
pks_kriminalitaetsatlas.title: Kriminalitätsatlas Berlin — Fallzahlen und Häufigkeitszahlen 2016–2025
pks_kriminalitaetsatlas.used_for: Offence rates per 100,000 residents (neighbourhood offences, assault, robbery, burglary, bike and car crime, all offences), mean of 2023–2025, per Bezirksregion.

senstadt_lor_2021.caveat: Region centre points are population-weighted, i.e. where people live, not the geometric middle of parks or rail yards.
senstadt_lor_2021.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen / Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg
senstadt_lor_2021.title: Lebensweltlich orientierte Räume (LOR) 2021 — Planungsräume (WGS84)
senstadt_lor_2021.used_for: Planning-area boundaries (area, centre points) and the official ‘Innere Stadt’ / ‘Äußere Stadt’ classification.

umweltgerechtigkeitsatlas_2023_2024.caveat: Classes are relative to the rest of Berlin (lowest quarter = low, highest quarter = high), not absolute health thresholds. The atlas's social-disadvantage indicator is deliberately not used.
umweltgerechtigkeitsatlas_2023_2024.publisher: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt
umweltgerechtigkeitsatlas_2023_2024.title: Umweltgerechtigkeitsatlas 2023/2024 (Broschüre), ‘Aufschlüsselung der Planungsräume nach Belastungssituation’
umweltgerechtigkeitsatlas_2023_2024.used_for: Noise, air, heat and green-space burden class (low / medium / high) per Planungsraum, weighted by residents to Bezirksregionen.

unfallatlas_2025.caveat: Only accidents with personal injury. Accidents count where they happened; main roads carry through traffic.
unfallatlas_2025.publisher: Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder
unfallatlas_2025.title: Unfallatlas — Unfallorte 2025 (Open Data)
unfallatlas_2025.used_for: Location and severity of every police-recorded road accident with personal injury in Berlin, counted per Bezirksregion.

vbb_gtfs.caveat: Buses are not counted: almost everyone in Berlin lives near one.
vbb_gtfs.title: VBB GTFS timetable — weekday peak network (07:00–09:00)
vbb_gtfs.used_for: S-Bahn, U-Bahn, regional-rail and tram stops with peak-hour service.
